intro.text: A lanky serving boy in Tvlakv's slave caravan who tends the chulls.

items.text: Taran was with the caravan when Tvlakv carried Kaladin and other slaves to the Shattered Plains. Like Bluth and Tag, he worked for Tvlakv rather than travelling in a cage.
When Shallan travels with Tvlakv's caravan, Taran is not with it, and Bluth looks after the chulls instead.
